root: Uni-CLI 0.400.2 defines the open Agent-Computer Interface runtime for discovering, selecting, governing, acting through, observing, and repairing operations across real software, while making fixed-core MCP routing limits explicit.

Deep retrieval now compiles natural arXiv queries into explicit syntax, filters bounded candidates for meaningful relevance, preserves publisher provenance, validates exact GitHub issue and pull-request URLs, and returns status-specific recovery guidance.

A bounded privacy-safe local event log now correlates CLI, MCP, ACP, bench, and hub operations with source identity and typed outcomes; recoverable locks, strict readers, and sanitized Commander errors keep diagnostics reliable without retaining raw user input.

Compute actions, waits, refs, sessions, and combined captures now bind to one exact app, renderer, transport, and native window identity; fresh-condition polling, target tombstones, atomic artifacts, and closed-failure capture prevent cross-target drift and false success.
zh: Uni-CLI 0.400.2 将项目明确为开放的 Agent-Computer Interface runtime：统一发现、选择、治理、执行、观察和修复真实软件操作，并如实暴露 fixed-core MCP 路由边界。
深度检索现在会把自然语言 arXiv 查询编译为显式语法，对有界候选执行实质相关性过滤，保留 publisher 来源，校验精确 GitHub issue/PR URL，并返回按状态区分的恢复动作。
新的有界隐私安全本地事件日志统一关联 CLI、MCP、ACP、bench 与 hub 操作，记录 source identity 和类型化结果；可恢复锁、严格读取器与脱敏 Commander 错误确保诊断可靠且不保留原始用户输入。
Compute action、wait、ref、session 与组合 capture 现在绑定同一 app、renderer、transport 和精确原生窗口；fresh 条件轮询、target tombstone、原子 artifact 与失败关闭 capture 消除跨目标漂移和假成功。
